verdict.rationale: Adyen for Platforms is a SaaS payments platform with a Dashboard, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair axis. The pack shows no built-in assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The official MCP server (docs-14, probe-4) lets external agents connect to Adyen's platform; that belongs to a different story and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
